The Title is mandatory and at most 100 characters. The Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date. The backend stores the task in a new table of the existing persistence database. The form shows a success or error message after the create action, and the frontend does not show success before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can capture their to-do items with
